description: Analyze genealogy records to identify age inconsistencies by calculating implied birth years and flagging discrepancies that exceed acceptable tolerance. Column E should calculate implied birth year (Record Date - Recorded Age). Column F should flag inconsistencies using IF(ABS(Known Birth Year - Implied Birth Year)>2,'INVESTIGATE','OK').

natural_language.prompt: You have genealogy research data with known birth years and census records. Calculate the implied birth year from each census record (Record Date - Recorded Age) in column E, then flag any records in column F where the implied birth year differs from the known birth year by more than 2 years.
